notes.title: RE0: VTuber Life English Version Launched!
notes.notes:
RE0: VTuber Life English Version has been launched!



We are thrilled to announce that the English version of RE0: VTuber Life is launched today!



RE0: VTuber Life is created by a small indie team that has long been fans of VTubers. The team decided to recreate a virtual world from what they had seen and heard. Whether you're a longtime fan or new to the world of VTubers, you can enjoy this release, which brings full English localization and improved gameplay features to welcome players from around the globe. 



Manage streams, make friends, gossip, interact with fans, and experience multiple endings. Each playthrough offers a new adventure with dynamic characters and unique scenarios.



We can’t wait for you to explore everything this game has to offer! Thank you for your support — we can’t wait to see you in the game! Stay tuned! 👾



— The RE0: VTuber Life Team

notes.title: RE0: VTuber Life English Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi y'all VTuber freaks! (speaking from a DD himself)

For the past few months, we've been working on the English version of RE0: VTuber Life, and the translation is done. Some testing work has to be done as well before it is ready.

Following our roadmap, and our sincere wish, we would like to have more content provided by our players, allowing them to contribute to the game—sharing some funny stories of their favorite VTubers or some gossip that once went viral in the community. We'd like to put them into our game!

Lots of work to be done, this is not the endgame. *wink*

Stay tuned for the future update! 

Join our Discord! To the VTuber Land! --> https://discord.gg/pPRmwDzT
